question_text: What was the average detection confidence across all events on 2025-12-08 (UTC)? Report to two decimal places.
answer_text: The average detection confidence across all events on 2025-12-08 (UTC) was 0.90.

citations.sql:
WITH confidence_data AS (
    SELECT confidence
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(confidence), 2) AS average_confidence
FROM confidence_data
